boot.title: We could not start SAMARTH AI
boot.body: The server did not respond. Check your connection and try again.

newVersion.title: A new version is available
newVersion.body: SAMARTH AI was updated. Reload the page to continue.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: We could not find that page. It may have moved, or you may not have access to it.

unauthorized.title: You do not have access
unauthorized.body: Your role does not allow this page. If you think this is wrong, contact your administrator.

serverError.title: Something went wrong
serverError.body: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again. If it keeps happening, share the request id below.

maintenance.title: Back soon
maintenance.body: SAMARTH AI is briefly unavailable for maintenance. We will reconnect automatically.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Check your internet connection. We will reconnect as soon as you are back online.

sessionExpired.title: Your session ended
sessionExpired.body: For your security you were signed out. Sign in again to continue where you left off.

accountSuspended.title: Account suspended
accountSuspended.body: An administrator has suspended this account. Contact your administrator to restore access.

accountLocked.title: Account temporarily locked
accountLocked.body: Too many unsuccessful sign-in attempts. You can try again in {{time}}, or reset your password now.

accountDeactivated.title: Account deactivated or scheduled for deletion
accountDeactivated.body: Sign in to reactivate it, or cancel the deletion within the 30-day grace period.

cookiesDisabled.title: Cookies are turned off
cookiesDisabled.body: SAMARTH AI needs cookies to keep you signed in. They are strictly necessary and used for nothing else. Turn on cookies for this site, then reload.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.body: This part of SAMARTH AI is planned for a later milestone.

getStarted.googleHint: You can also continue with Google on the sign-up page.

invitations.title: How invitations work
steps: An administrator invites you by email. Trainer and admin accounts are created this way.
Open the invitation link in that email. It works once and expires after 7 days.
Set your name and password, and you are in.
invitations.note: Cannot find your invitation? Ask your administrator to send a new one.

offline.stillOffline: Still offline. Check your connection and try again.

cookiesDisabled.enabledNow: Cookies are turned on for this site. You can continue.
steps: Open your browser settings and find the cookie or site data options.

comingSoon.featureLine: {{feature}} is planned for a later milestone.

verifyCertificate.title: Verify a certificate
verifyCertificate.body: Public certificate verification is planned for a later milestone. Once it is built, anyone will be able to check a SAMARTH AI certificate code here without signing in.
verifyCertificate.note: This is a prototype. No certificates are issued yet.
